decks.notes: The main idea behind this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly flood the board with cheap and efficient creatures like Thraben Inspector and Seeker of the Way, while also using burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast to control the opponent's board and maintain tempo. The deck aims to constantly pressure the opponent with early aggression and efficient removal spells, utilizing cards like Glint Hawk and Kor Skyfisher to maximize value and card advantage. Overall, the focus is on putting pressure on the opponent and maintaining a fast-paced game plan.

The main concept of the deck is to control the game by using removal spells and sacrificing creatures for value. The deck focuses on generating card advantage through sacrificing creatures with effects like Deadly Dispute and Fanatical Offering, while also utilizing cards like Thorn of the Black Rose to maintain card advantage. Crypt Rats serves as a board wipe option, while Troll of Khazad-dûm and Avenging Hunter provide strong threats that can help close out the game. The mana base includes lands like Khalni Garden for token generation and fixing, creating a strong Golgari control deck.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish a strong board presence by playing cheap artifacts and utilizing cards that benefit from having artifacts in play. By utilizing cards like "All That Glitters" and "Moon-Circuit Hacker", the deck aims to pump up its creatures and finish the game quickly by attacking aggressively. The deck also includes cards like "Metallic Rebuke" for disruption and card draw spells like "Thoughtcast" to keep up its momentum. By efficiently using artifacts and synergistic cards, this deck aims to overwhelm its opponent with a flood of aggressive creatures.

The deck focuses on utilizing flicker effects to repeatedly trigger powerful enter the battlefield abilities, generating card advantage and value. By combining cards like Snap, Ephemerate, and Ghostly Flicker with creatures like Mulldrifter and Archaeomancer, the deck aims to control the board while drawing cards and gaining life. Sunscape Familiar and God-Pharaoh's Faithful help reduce the cost of spells, while counterspells like Prohibit and Remove Soul protect the combo pieces. The deck's win condition can come from overwhelming the opponent with card advantage or assembling a combo for a decisive victory.

The concept of this deck is to quickly swarm the battlefield with artifacts and buff them with enchantments like All That Glitters to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful army. Springleaf Drum and Moon-Circuit Hacker help generate mana and facilitate fast plays, while Metallic Rebuke provides control against opposing decks. Myr Enforcer and Ornithopter are key creatures in this strategy, supported by card draw engines like Thoughtcast and Of One Mind. The inclusion of Thraben Inspector adds a bit of extra value and card advantage to this aggressive Affinity archetype.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to maintain board control and disruption through counterspells, removal spells, and bounce effects, while also utilizing card advantage and card selection to stay ahead of the opponent. The Faerie tribe synergizes well with the deck's strategy, providing early game blockers and additional disruption with Spellstutter Sprite. The inclusion of Gurmag Angler and Murmuring Mystic offer potent win conditions once the opponent's resources have been sufficiently depleted. The deck aims to outlast opponents through a combination of tempo plays and resource denial.

The main focus of the deck is to control the game by using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures like Spellstutter Sprite and Ninja of the Deep Hours. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan while digging for answers and threats with cards like Preordain, Brainstorm, and Augur of Bolas. The win condition of the deck is to establish board presence with Faerie creatures and finish off the opponent with high impact spells like Snuff Out and Gurmag Angler. The deck also includes utility lands like Bojuka Bog and Dimir Aqueduct for added flexibility.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize sacrifice effects and tokens to control the board and disrupt opponent's strategy. By sacrificing tokens created by cards like Khalni Garden and Tithing Blade, along with Crypt Rats for board wipes, the deck aims to maintain board control and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Thorn of the Black Rose and Avenging Hunter provide additional value and card advantage. The mana base includes lands like Witch's Cottage and Bojuka Bog to support the Golgari/Jund color identity of the deck.

This deck focuses on quickly playing cheap artifacts and creatures to build a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive, efficient attacks. By combining the affinity mechanic with the power of cards like All That Glitters and Thoughtcast, the deck can quickly amass a large army of creatures and pump them up for massive damage. The inclusion of cards like Moon-Circuit Hacker and Gingerbrute allows for evasion and protection, ensuring that the aggressive strategy can continue unimpeded. Overall, this deck aims to quickly establish dominance on the battlefield and secure a swift victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing Gates to generate mana and produce defensive creatures, while also using Counterspells and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to establish board presence with efficient creatures like Squadron Hawk and Sacred Cat, while also maintaining card advantage through card draw and filtering effects like Brainstorm and Preordain. By efficiently managing resources and disrupting the opponent's plays, this deck looks to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent in a battle of attrition.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying a board of artifact creatures like Gingerbrute and Myr Enforcer, while using cards like Metallic Rebuke and Thoughtcast to control the game. All That Glitters enhances the power of creatures, allowing for massive amounts of damage to be dealt quickly. Springleaf Drum helps accelerate the mana base, while Novice Inspector and Thraben Inspector provide card advantage. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats and card advantage, while also having the flexibility to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on using cards that can put creatures into the graveyard and then quickly reanimate them to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Dread Return, Exhume, and Acorn Harvest, the deck can bring back powerful creatures like Lotleth Giant and Troll of Khazad-dûm. The deck also includes cards like Gnaw to the Bone and Generous Ent to gain life and generate tokens, creating a strong board presence and a resilient strategy. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble powerful creatures and overwhelm the opponent with its reanimation combo.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using a combination of removal spells, creature sacrifice effects, and card draw engines to outvalue and outlast opponents. It aims to generate incremental advantages through efficient removal like Cast Down and Crypt Rats, while also generating value with cards like Ichor Wellspring and Deadly Dispute. It utilizes cards like Thorn of the Black Rose and Troll of Khazad-dûm to maintain card advantage and pressure opponents. The deck also includes a mix of graveyard hate and lifegain to disrupt opponent strategies and stabilize the game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board by using a combination of counter spells, removal spells, and card advantage engines. It utilizes cards like Skred and Lightning Bolt to deal with threats, while also having access to card draw with Ponder and Augur of Bolas. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Azure Fleet Admiral and Lórien Revealed. The mana base is optimized with Snow-Covered Islands and Mountains, with some utility lands like Volatile Fjord and Ash Barrens. Overall, this deck aims to out-value and outlast opponents through efficient control and card advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize Golgari/Jund creatures and removal spells to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck focuses on generating value through sacrificing creatures, drawing cards, and gaining life. It also aims to maintain board presence with token generators like Khalni Garden and Lembas. The inclusion of cards like Crypt Rats and Troll of Khazad-dûm provide additional control options, while cards like Thorn of the Black Rose help maintain card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and grind out a victory through attrition.

The deck focuses on utilizing flicker effects and control spells to outvalue the opponent and maintain card advantage. By bouncing creatures back to hand or flickering them, the deck can generate incremental value while controlling the board with counterspells and removal. The use of card draw and filtering helps ensure the player has the resources they need to outlast their opponent in a longer game. The deck aims to stabilize early on and then grind out a win through card advantage and efficient removal spells.
